newsitem.title: USA: EDS in $325 mln pact with South African bank.
newsitem.headline: EDS in $325 mln pact with South African bank.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp said on Thursday that South Africa's First National Bank had appointed the company to manage and operate its check processing and centralized back-office ledger functions in a $325 million deal.

Under the 10-year contract, EDS will assume control of First National's existing operations at 22 locations, re-engineer certain processes and, where appropriate, upgrade the technology, EDS said in a statement.
The deal is effective July 1 and about 550 bank employees will be employed by EDS as a result of the agreement, EDS said.
